scenes.dialogue: Can a wife who earns a salary still claim maintenance? Can parents claim from a married daughter? Does jail wipe out arrears?
Hi, I'm Ravishankar from LawWorld. Who can claim maintenance, how much can be ordered, and how is the order enforced?
The law is Section One Forty Four of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, or B N S S, which replaces Section One Twenty Five of the old Code.
scenes.shown: The law is Section 144 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, or BNSS, which replaces Section 125 of the old Code.

scenes.dialogue: Under the old Code, Chaturbhuj versus Sita Bai calls it a measure of social justice. Its object is to prevent vagrancy and destitution.
So who can claim? Four groups of relatives, against a person with sufficient means who neglects or refuses to maintain them.
First, a wife unable to maintain herself. Second, a child, legitimate or illegitimate, unable to maintain itself.
Third, an adult child, other than a married daughter, unable to maintain itself because of a physical or mental abnormality or injury.
Fourth, a parent unable to maintain themselves. Vijaya Manohar Arbat, under the old Code, holds that parents may claim from a daughter with means of her own.
Unlike the old Code, clause B no longer uses the word minor. Whether that helps adult children is not yet settled by the courts.
scenes.shown: Unlike the old Code, clause (b) no longer uses the word “minor”. Whether that helps adult children is not yet settled by the courts.

scenes.dialogue: For this Chapter, wife also includes a divorced woman who has not remarried.
scenes.shown: For this Chapter, “wife” also includes a divorced woman who has not remarried.

scenes.dialogue: The remedy is secular. The Supreme Court has held, under the old Code, that it covers women of every faith.
Here is a hypothetical. Deepa and her young son live with her parents. Her husband Raghu, an engineer, has stopped paying for them.
Deepa earns a little from tutoring. Under Chaturbhuj, that alone does not end her claim. Can she live as she did in her husband's home?
In Anju Garg, under the old Code, the Supreme Court said an able bodied husband must earn, even by physical labour.
scenes.shown: In Anju Garg, under the old Code, the Supreme Court said an able-bodied husband must earn, even by physical labour.

scenes.dialogue: How much? There is no statutory ceiling. The old limit of five hundred rupees a month was removed in two thousand one.
scenes.shown: How much? There is no statutory ceiling. The old limit of ₹500 a month was removed in 2001.

scenes.dialogue: The Magistrate fixes a monthly rate, weighing status, reasonable needs, independent income and the standard of living.
Rajnesh versus Neha, under the old Code, says it must neither oppress the payer, nor be so meagre that it drives the wife to penury.
Pending the case, interim maintenance and expenses may be ordered, as far as possible within sixty days of notice.
scenes.shown: Pending the case, interim maintenance and expenses may be ordered, as far as possible within 60 days of notice.

scenes.dialogue: Sub section Two: the allowance runs from the date of the order or, if the court so orders, from the date of the application.
scenes.shown: Sub-section (2): the allowance runs from the date of the order or, if the court so orders, from the date of the application.

scenes.dialogue: Rajnesh directed that maintenance be awarded from the date of application, since delays are beyond the applicant's control.
It also made a disclosure affidavit of assets and liabilities mandatory for both sides. False statements in it may invite perjury proceedings.
Claiming under another law too, like the Domestic Violence Act? Disclose that order. The court will consider adjusting the amounts.
Sub section Four bars a wife who lives in adultery, refuses without sufficient reason to live with her husband, or lives apart by mutual consent.
scenes.shown: Sub-section (4) bars a wife who lives in adultery, refuses without sufficient reason to live with her husband, or lives apart by mutual consent.

scenes.dialogue: Proof of any of these also requires the Magistrate to cancel an existing order.
Suppose Raghu offers maintenance only if Deepa returns. The Magistrate may weigh her reasons, and still order it on just ground.
The law itself treats his marrying another woman as a just ground for her refusal.
If Raghu fails without sufficient cause to pay, the Magistrate may issue a warrant, for every breach, to levy the amount due.
For each month's allowance left unpaid after the warrant, he may be imprisoned for up to one month, or until he pays, if sooner.
But there is a time limit. Deepa must apply to levy the amount within one year of the date on which it became due.
Jail does not wipe out the debt. Kuldip Kaur, under the old Code, calls imprisonment a mode of enforcement, not satisfaction.
Section One Forty Five lets Deepa file where Raghu is, where he or his wife resides, or where he last resided with his wife.
scenes.shown: Section 145 lets Deepa file where Raghu is, where he or his wife resides, or where he last resided with his wife.
scenes.chip: 9 · WHERE TO FILE, AND LATER CHANGES

scenes.dialogue: The B N S S adds a new option: the district where his father or mother resides.
scenes.shown: The BNSS adds a new option: the district where his father or mother resides.

scenes.dialogue: Where a Family Court has been set up for the area, it exercises this jurisdiction.
Under Section One Forty Six, the Magistrate may alter the order on proof of a change in the circumstances of either party.
scenes.shown: Under Section 146, the Magistrate may alter the order on proof of a change in the circumstances of either party.

scenes.dialogue: Finally, a checklist. Gather proof of the relationship, the respondent's income and assets, and your own monthly expenses.
File the disclosure affidavit with your application, and seek interim maintenance early. If payments stop, apply within one year of each missed payment.
Maintenance prevents destitution; it is not a penalty. The amount always depends on the evidence before the court.
